verdict.rationale: Paystack's own marketing says merchants can integrate once and let customers pay however they want, which matches the single-integration, multi-method core of the story. It never names any specific method, so the support is only a glancing claim. Missing for 10: documented Apple Pay support, Google Pay support, bank redirect/local payment methods, BNPL support, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Integrate Paystack once and let your customers pay you however they want.
We automatically route payments through the most optimal channels
